attempts.summary: Built a WireGuard tunnel between node1 and node2 over the transit network and routed the private lan-a/lan-b subnets across it, so node3 (10.10.10.2) and node4 (10.10.20.2) reach each other by private address with traffic encrypted in transit. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time and verified to recover fully (boot identity changed, tunnel/routes re-established, end-to-end connectivity and encryption confirmed post-restart).
